title: A capture you place from the Library keeps its own name
goal: When you drop a capture from the Library into a picture, the new layer is called "Pasted Image". It should be called what the file is called, so a stack of placed captures is readable in the layers list.
notes: Came out of the Library panel task (2026-09-03). EditorState.placeLibraryPick -> addImageLayerOrOpen -> pasteImage, which hardcodes the Pasted Image name. Give the image-landing path an optional name and pass the URLs last path component from both the Library and the Finder drop.
acceptance: Placing a capture from the Library names the layer after the file, without its extension
Dropping an image file from the Finder names the layer the same way
Pasting an image from the clipboard, which has no file name, still reads Pasted Image
Renaming the layer afterwards still works and survives undo
